scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:types && concurrently -n renderer,main -c blue,green --kill-others "npm -w apps/renderer run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:1420 && npm -w apps/main run dev"
scripts.dev:renderer: npm run build:types && npm -w apps/renderer run dev
scripts.dev:main: npm run build:core && npm run build:types && npm -w apps/main run dev
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:types && npm -w apps/renderer run build
scripts.build:main: npm run build:types && npm -w apps/main run build
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:types && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @pa/ipc-types run typecheck && npm -w apps/renderer run typecheck && npm -w apps/main run typecheck
